prompt:
This image is one page of an official LEGO building-instruction booklet. Turn the build shown in the
numbered step(s) and callout boxes into assembly steps. Follow the arrows and the order shown. If the page says a step
is repeated (e.g. "5x"), describe ONE unit and say "(repeat 5x)" in that instruction, don't add separate repeat
steps. Pins, studs and holes that are already part of a model are not separate parts. Ignore page numbers, progress
bars and decorative icons.
Return ONLY a JSON object, no prose:
{"title": "<what is being built>",
  "parts": [{"id": "<kebab-case id>", "name": "<short name>", "description": "<colour/shape, how to recognise it>"}],
  "steps": [{"instruction": "<one imperative sentence for a person building it at a table>",
              "highlight": ["<part ids this step uses>"],
              "check": "<what to verify after the step, e.g. orientation/polarity/seating; empty if none>",
              "question": "<a yes/no question a camera could answer to confirm the step is done; empty if none>"}],
  "completion": "<short message when finished>"}
Use these ids (and colours) when a part matches - the detector knows them: legs = tan/beige LEGO minifigure legs (hip piece with two legs); torso = light-blue printed LEGO minifigure torso; its two yellow arms belong to the torso; head = yellow LEGO minifigure head: a small round yellow cylinder with a printed face (not the torso's arms, not the yellow pin on the car); hairpiece = orange LEGO minifigure hair piece; tire = black rubber LEGO tire (a black ring), with or without a rim inside; rim = dark grey (almost black) plastic LEGO wheel hub on its own, without a tire (official booklet colour); axle-pin = small yellow axle pin sticking out of the left side of the LEGO car chassis.
Describe parts by their real colour as printed in the booklet.
One step per join or connection, in build order, 1-12 steps.
warnings: setup step 'Place the tan minifigure legs on the tab' folded into the next step
